scope_boundaries: The fixed upper allocation is an auxiliary whole-box assignment. It agrees with the pre-existing numerical action at the upper tuple only; it does not claim equality with every actual tuple's individually rerun greedy action.

The final theorem proves endpoint group targets; actual tuple factors have separate exact product and coordinatewise bounds. It does not silently assert arbitrary quotient-containing expressions are monotone without positivity/algebra.

A caller still supplies original policy support, original roughness/width bounds, actual<=upper, and actual endpoint log coordinates in the same closed physical cell. These must be established for the original fine boxes, including rounding and any nonempty-source witness. They are not a caller assignment or remainder-square license.

Original signed coefficient regrouping, factorial normalization, the actual grouped Cartesian carriers, distribution mean and small-factor attachment remain separate. Individual decision fibres are never called Cartesian.
